title: "I Feel Good" and closing the day
summary: She says her brother George wrote "I Feel Good", sings it, and the session ends.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: That song "I Feel Good." You wrote that.
George (Singing) "I feel good. I really love my baby. I feel good."
"I don't mean maybe. I love my wife, I love my man (inaudible), I feel good." (Inaudible). Got that music somewhere around here.
Does that make you feel good when you sing that song?
I can sing it now, because the man that used to bug me to death is dead. But Lord have mercy, I couldn't sing it years ago.
I feel good when I listen to you sing that song.
Yeah, I play it up very loud. Uh-huh, I love it. It makes me feel good when I hear you sing that. Yeah, it's a very good tune.
(Unintelligible), but I never did try to sing it. (Unintelligible), "I Feel Good."
Well, I think we'll come to church tomorrow and maybe talk some more afterwards, okay?
